map.title: Rational quantities and proportional reasoning seed
map.description: A candidate map slice used to test the Open Learning Atlas v0.1 constitution and schema. It is not a curriculum or learning sequence.

sources.title: Open Learning Atlas v0.1 contributor analysis
sources.citation: Initial ontology and map-slice analysis drafted for Open Learning Atlas on 2026-07-21.
sources.notes: This source records design reasoning, not independent empirical validation. Every record remains a candidate.

nodes.label: Rational number
nodes.definition: A number expressible as a quotient a/b of integers where b is nonzero.

nodes.label: Ratio
nodes.definition: A multiplicative relationship between two quantities, with order and units interpreted from context.

excludes: Treating every ordered pair as a ratio

nodes.label: Proportional relationship
nodes.definition: A relationship between two quantities expressible as y = kx over a stated domain for a constant k.

nodes.label: Fraction notation
nodes.definition: The written form a/b. Context determines whether it expresses a number, quotient, ratio, rate, operator, or another related meaning.

nodes.label: Paired-quantity table
nodes.definition: A table aligning values of two varying quantities. It may represent either a proportional or non-proportional relationship.

nodes.label: Number line
nodes.definition: A spatial representation in which positions on an oriented line correspond to numbers and their order and distance relationships.

nodes.label: Fraction equivalence invariance
nodes.definition: Multiplying or dividing a fraction's numerator and denominator by the same nonzero number preserves the represented rational number.

nodes.label: Interpret fraction notation
nodes.definition: Interpret what a fraction-form expression denotes in a stated context without assuming that the notation has only one meaning.
nodes.capability_statement: Given a/b in a bounded context, identify the represented quantity and explain its meaning as a quotient, magnitude, equal-part relationship, ratio, or rate as appropriate.

excludes: Operating on fractions as a separate procedure

nodes.label: Compute a quotient
nodes.definition: Determine the result of division for a bounded class of numerical quantities while respecting stated precision and units.
nodes.capability_statement: Given two numerical quantities and a nonzero divisor, determine their quotient to the precision appropriate to the stated task, preserving or deriving units when relevant.

excludes: Selecting division as the appropriate model

nodes.label: Locate a rational number on a number line
nodes.definition: Place a point at the magnitude represented by a rational number on a suitably scaled number line.
nodes.capability_statement: Given a rational number and a suitably partitioned number line, locate the corresponding point and explain how the scale determines its position.

nodes.label: Compare nonnegative rational magnitudes
nodes.definition: Determine the order of two nonnegative rational numbers and justify the comparison using an admissible method.
nodes.capability_statement: Given two nonnegative rational numbers in specified representations, determine their order and justify the conclusion using a benchmark, common representation, or magnitude model.

nodes.label: Interpret a ratio
nodes.definition: State the multiplicative comparison or composed measure represented by a ratio, including the meaning of order and units.
nodes.capability_statement: Given two quantities in context, state and explain the multiplicative comparison or composed measure expressed by their ratio, including the meaning of its order and units.

nodes.label: Construct an equivalent ratio
nodes.definition: Produce another ratio that preserves the same multiplicative relationship and justify the equivalence.
nodes.capability_statement: Given a ratio, construct another ratio expressing the same multiplicative relationship and justify why the relationship is preserved.

nodes.label: Determine a unit rate
nodes.definition: Determine and interpret the amount of one quantity corresponding to one unit of another quantity.
nodes.capability_statement: Given a numerical ratio with a nonzero second quantity, determine and interpret the amount corresponding to one unit of that quantity, including appropriate units.

nodes.label: Identify a proportional relationship
nodes.definition: Determine whether two varying quantities exhibit a proportional relationship over a stated dataset or domain.
nodes.capability_statement: Given information about two varying quantities, determine whether a proportional relationship holds over the stated data or domain and justify the determination.

nodes.label: Determine a missing proportional value
nodes.definition: Find an unknown corresponding value in a proportional relationship using a valid method and state the reasoning.
nodes.capability_statement: Given a proportional relationship and sufficient known values, determine an unknown corresponding value and state the reasoning used.

nodes.label: Justify multiplicative reasoning
nodes.definition: Support a multiplicative conclusion by selecting relevant quantities, representations, definitions, or invariants and explaining why the conclusion follows; calculation alone is insufficient.
nodes.capability_statement: Given a multiplicative conclusion, select relevant quantities, representations, definitions, or invariants and explain why the conclusion follows rather than presenting calculation alone.

nodes.label: Proportional reasoning
nodes.definition: A navigation-level grouping for interpreting ratios, recognizing proportionality, determining values, and justifying multiplicative conclusions. Membership does not by itself define mastery or sequence.

edges.subject: ola:n:305a66a3-9e56-4b82-8530-1e0dc46a4a09
conditions: Context establishes that a/b denotes a number rather than another fraction-form meaning
edges.rationale: Every rational number can be expressed in fraction notation, although the notation is contextually ambiguous.

edges.subject: ola:n:305a66a3-9e56-4b82-8530-1e0dc46a4a09
conditions: Context establishes the two compared quantities and their order
edges.rationale: Fraction notation can express a ratio, but the notation alone does not establish the contextual quantities.

edges.subject: ola:n:daea78b3-eff0-4883-bf76-628690669692
conditions: The paired values exhibit a constant multiplicative relationship
edges.rationale: A paired-quantity table can represent a proportional relationship when its values satisfy the defining invariant.

edges.subject: ola:n:7218786d-06d5-458f-aa37-ca911d8d003e
edges.rationale: Rational numbers correspond to positions on a number line, making magnitude and order spatially inspectable.

edges.subject: ola:n:504bd765-46a9-4d23-8a71-9236683aea84
edges.scope: When the notation denotes rational magnitude or quotient.
edges.rationale: Interpreting fraction notation in these meanings invokes the rational-number concept.

edges.subject: ola:n:504bd765-46a9-4d23-8a71-9236683aea84
edges.rationale: The capability is specifically bounded around interpreting fraction notation.

edges.subject: ola:n:a0c1ba69-bcbb-464a-8c41-a35df1386359
edges.rationale: The capability locates the magnitude of a rational number.

edges.subject: ola:n:a0c1ba69-bcbb-464a-8c41-a35df1386359
edges.rationale: A number line is the output and interpretive frame of the capability.

edges.subject: ola:n:47ea4cdf-bd9a-4617-b68b-ffdf0436d4e1
edges.rationale: The compared objects are rational magnitudes.

edges.subject: ola:n:47ea4cdf-bd9a-4617-b68b-ffdf0436d4e1
edges.rationale: The capability requires a valid justification, not only selection of a comparison symbol.

edges.subject: ola:n:47ea4cdf-bd9a-4617-b68b-ffdf0436d4e1
edges.rationale: Locating rational values on a number line provides one strong comparison strategy, but it is not the only admissible route.

edges.subject: ola:n:588e1faf-e01b-436a-8426-75a3fe014d18
edges.rationale: The capability operationalizes the meaning of a ratio in context.

edges.subject: ola:n:4f6e553a-26c7-46a8-86e3-c3527f3fcb61
edges.rationale: Equivalent ratios preserve the underlying multiplicative relationship.

edges.subject: ola:n:4f6e553a-26c7-46a8-86e3-c3527f3fcb61
conditions: The capability includes explaining why the constructed ratio is equivalent
edges.rationale: Blindly scaling two numerals does not satisfy the defined capability; the preserved multiplicative relationship must be interpreted.

edges.subject: ola:n:80dd02b4-f9af-416e-b6d0-9f2aa771f509
edges.rationale: A unit rate is derived from and interpreted as a ratio of quantities.

edges.subject: ola:n:80dd02b4-f9af-416e-b6d0-9f2aa771f509
conditions: The unit rate must be numerically calculated
edges.rationale: Producing an amount per one requires forming a quotient for the stated quantities.

edges.subject: ola:n:80dd02b4-f9af-416e-b6d0-9f2aa771f509
conditions: The result must be interpreted in context with correct quantity order and units
edges.rationale: A bare quotient does not satisfy a unit-rate interpretation when its quantities or units are misunderstood.

edges.subject: ola:n:f4c1632f-8a30-4f73-88da-c3252eff7726
edges.rationale: The classification is made against the definition of a proportional relationship.

edges.subject: ola:n:f4c1632f-8a30-4f73-88da-c3252eff7726
edges.rationale: A paired-quantity table is one representation in which proportionality can be inspected.

edges.subject: ola:n:f4c1632f-8a30-4f73-88da-c3252eff7726
conditions: Finite numerical data are inspected with an equivalent-ratio method
edges.rationale: Constructing equivalent ratios provides one valid route to testing whether pairs preserve a common relationship.

edges.subject: ola:n:f4c1632f-8a30-4f73-88da-c3252eff7726
conditions: Finite numerical data are inspected with a constant-unit-rate method
edges.rationale: Determining unit rates provides another valid route to testing proportionality.

edges.subject: ola:n:0a9060ad-8834-4e50-8b94-44a52bddd0e8
conditions: The prompt does not stipulate that the relationship is proportional
edges.rationale: Applying proportional machinery responsibly first requires establishing that the model fits when proportionality is not given.

edges.subject: ola:n:01763879-09da-4b19-b9be-b8cd54e3e0ab
edges.rationale: Interpreting ratios is one component of the proportional-reasoning map region.

edges.subject: ola:n:01763879-09da-4b19-b9be-b8cd54e3e0ab
edges.rationale: Recognizing proportional relationships is one component of the proportional-reasoning map region.

edges.subject: ola:n:01763879-09da-4b19-b9be-b8cd54e3e0ab
edges.rationale: Determining unknown values is one application component of the proportional-reasoning map region.

conditions: The relationship is stipulated to be proportional
Equivalent-ratio and unit-rate methods are both admissible
requirement_groups.rationale: The target can be performed through either equivalent-ratio reasoning or unit-rate reasoning; neither method is a universal prerequisite by itself.
requirement_groups.review_notes: This record tests disjunctive, conditional requirements. Additional valid methods may need to be added.
